exact_quote: In PTX, the fundamental types reflect the native data types supported by the target architectures. A fundamental type specifies both a basic type and a size. Register variables are always of a fundamental type, and instructions operate on these types. The same type-size specifiers are used for both variable definitions and for typing instructions, so their names are intentionally short.
